ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 1:12 ratio of high-intensity (white/grey) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Base pigmentation is uniformly dark (low-intensity). High-contrast white/grey pixels are arranged in discrete circular clusters and hollow ring formations scattered across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Centrally located V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 52 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Trailing edge displays continuous small-scale serrations; distal tips exhibit extreme irregular topography with large-scale protrusions breaking the linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Upward-trending convex arc with increased curvature toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous circular and annular high-contrast clusters (diameters 5-15 pixels) distributed across both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large clusters of high-relief, irregular white/beige structures attached to distal tips; widespread circular depigmentation (rings) on the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy accumulation of textured, high-contrast masses on the terminal ends of both lobes, significantly distorting the fluke's natural trailing edge geometry.
